title: fsrs-params-publish job payload v1
description: app.job.payload of the server-internal job kind `fsrs-params-publish` (FSRS_PUBLISH.md, C-16). Written by the worker's `fsrs-optimize` job, read by the server's FsrsParamsPublishRunner, never by the API. Closed: the runner fails a payload with an unknown member (`invalid_payload`). The schema cannot express three cross-member rules, which the runner also checks (FSRS_PUBLISH.md 2.2): log_loss_after < log_loss_before; holdout_review_count < review_count; weights within the per-index bounds of contracts/sync/ops/fsrs_params.published.schema.json.

format_version.description: Payload format; 1. Any other value fails the child with `unsupported_format` (checked before the rest of the schema).

parent_job_id.description: Id of the public `fsrs-optimize` job (the parent) whose worker inserted this row.

preset_id.description: The preset (app.fsrs_params.id) the weights are for. Equals the parent's payload.preset_id.

base_weights_version.description: The preset's weights_version the worker read in its planning snapshot; `log_loss_before` was measured with the weights of that version (version 0 = the built-in default weights). The op is minted with weights_version = base_weights_version + 1, and only if the stored version still equals this value (else `stale_base`).

fsrs_version.description: FSRS algorithm version of `weights`; copied to the op. Only "6" in format 1.

weights.description: The 21 FSRS-6 weights w[0]..w[20], exactly the values `log_loss_after` and `rmse_bins` were measured with (after any clamping or rounding the worker does). The runner copies them to the op unchanged. Per-index bounds are those of the op schema (C-1); the runner enforces them by validating the op it builds (`weights_out_of_bounds`).

optimized_at.description: When the optimizer run finished: integer milliseconds since the Unix epoch, UTC (worker clock). Copied to the op's optimized_at; never compared with another clock.

review_count.description: review_log rows the run used in total (training + held-out).

holdout_review_count.description: How many of those rows form the held-out set both log losses were measured on. Strictly less than review_count (cross-member rule).

log_loss_before.description: Mean binary log loss on the held-out set with the preset's weights as of base_weights_version.

log_loss_after.description: Mean binary log loss on the same held-out set with `weights`. Strictly less than log_loss_before (cross-member rule): the publish-only-if-better gate.

rmse_bins.description: RMSE (bins) of `weights` on the held-out set.
